title: State Complexity of Shifts of the Fibonacci Word
summary: The Fibonacci infinite word ${\bf f} = (f_i)_{i \geq 0} = 01001010\cdots$ is one of the most celebrated objects in combinatorics on words. There is a simple $5$-state automaton that, given $i$ in lsd-first Zeckendorf representation, computes its $i$'th term $f_i$, and a $2$-state automaton for msd-first. In this paper we consider the state complexity of the automaton generating the shifted sequence $(f_{i+c})_{i \geq 0}$, and show that it is $O(\log c)$ for both msd-first and lsd-first input.
